--- create_sequence_bit_reversed_positive.sql
CREATE SEQUENCE MySequence BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE
--- AST
&ast.CreateSequence{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 16,
        NameEnd: 26,
        Name:    "MySequence",
      },
    },
  },
  Params: []ast.SequenceParam{
    &ast.BitReversedPositive{
      BitReversedPositive: 27,
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEQUENCE MySequence BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE
